The following instructions provide a useful guide in laying out an office space for general business:

• Place desks next to each other, both to the side and opposite
• Set up at each desk a personal computer
    ◦ Screen in the middle
    ◦ Computer on the right
    ◦ Stationery on the left
• Employees should have someone next to them, as well as opposite
• Organise seating arrangement due to role and into project teams
• If possible, leave a room available for private meetings – at minimum, create a secluded space within the main office
• Make sure there is direct access to the bathroom, the exit, and, if possible, a catering area

Note: Desk placement is susceptible to change given the shape and size of the office room.

The following guide is designed to help with various common causes of car wheel and tyre failures that occur, how to spot them and how to avoid them:

• Make sure that your tyres’ tread depth is at least 3mm across ¾ of the tyre and around the entire circumference.
    ◦ If your tyre wear is uneven, take your car to a tyre centre. They may be misaligned and need to be checked.
• When you are driving with abnormally distributed excess weight, such as multiple passengers or heavy loads, adjust your tyre pressure accordingly.
• Always make sure you have a tyre inflator and sealant kit available in the car for emergencies.
    ◦ If you do not have these materials, make sure instead that you have a carjack on hand.
• Always keep a spare wheel at home. Make sure it is correctly inflated and has good tread depth.

The key is to be diligent and prepared for any outcome. If you follow these simple steps, you should be able to circumvent any tyre or wheel trouble that you may find yourself in.

Here is a list of instructions to enable you to whitelist any email address you wish. With this, you can prohibit messages sent by specific email addresses from reaching your inbox:

• Click on Preferences from the Menu drop-down list
• Click the button labelled ‘Restrict Incoming Email’
• When prompted “Enable Email Controls?” - enter ‘Yes’
• Enter your password
• Locate the emails you wish to whitelist from your addresses
• Select the tick-box next to these address
• Finish by clicking the button labelled ‘Complete’

Note: After pressing ‘Complete,’ you will be returned to your email inbox.

Here is a list of instructions to enable you to set up parental controls on your TV box. You will need:

• Your TV box remote
• Your TV box to be connected to a phone line or your home broadband
• Your TV box password

Once you have these conditions sorted, proceed to follow this guide:

• Click the button labelled “Menu” on your TV box remote
• Using the left-right arrow buttons, locate the ‘Family’ tab and press the select button
• Locate the choice marked “Parental Control” and press the select button
• Enter your TV box password
• Using the arrow keys, move the “Setting” heading from OFF to ON
• Once ON, you can select which channels will require a password
• Once done, press the Blue button to save your settings
